diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions without obtaining new state or progress, especially repeated clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged outcomes forces strategy revision or termination, reducing futile action loops and interaction cost. The added state comparison and one retry checkpoint impose small memory and reasoning overhead.
policy_text: Before repeating an action, compare the latest observable state and result with the previous attempt. If nothing materially changed, retry at most once with a stated correction; then switch strategy, gather new information, or stop and report the blocker. Never continue an unchanged action loop.

quantitative_evidence.finding: result:repeated has +1,261 operations of candidate/bad excess, representing 11.31% of the profile's reported 11,146 total magnitude; it is the second-largest flat differential result.

Within repeated outcomes, candidate/bad excess includes +639 clicks, +356 no-ops, and +277 scrolls; by contrast, fills are -12 and select_option actions are -21, showing concentration in repeated low-progress interaction.

Traces reproduce multi-step recurrence: one candidate session repeats the same buy_tickets click on the same subtask at steps 0007, 0014–0021, and 0027; another repeats the same search click at consecutive steps 0006–0007.
